facts.text: Enrolled students can take CTU Fast Track exams at no additional cost, potentially earning college credit for prior knowledge to reduce degree time and tuition by up to 30%.

sources.title: Fast Track Online Degrees | Colorado Technical University
sources.quote: By passing CTU Fast Track™ exams you can save up to 30% on time and tuition by earning college credit for prior knowledge*. Fast Track exams are available at no additional cost to all CTU students.
